The Craft of Computing is the first course for Information Sciences major and
minor students at Azim Premji University. It is a hands-on exploration of
computing: getting comfortable with the command line, learning Python, and
using sensors and microcontrollers to interact with the world outside the
screen.

## Who this course is for

This course is designed for absolute beginners. No prior programming experience
or familiarity with technical tools is required. If you already have some
experience, the course offers ideas and challenges that will deepen your
understanding.

The skills and habits you develop here provide a strong foundation for a
lifetime of learning in computing.

## How you will learn

Each lesson focuses on one idea and explains it through examples you can try.
Practice problems at the end give you a chance to put that idea to use. A short
summary helps you return to the lesson later.

## Instructor

This course is designed and taught by [Anand Chitipothu](https://anandology.com/).

The [schedule](overview/schedule.qmd) lists what is covered each week.
